# PictureProfileKind

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Imaging` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public enum PictureProfileKind
```

What an imported picture's embedded color profile means for it.

## Values

- <span id="f-none"></span>`None = 0` - No profile: the pixels are taken as sRGB, as every browser and marketplace does.
- <span id="f-srgb"></span>`Srgb = 1` - An sRGB profile: the pixels already mean what they will be shown as.
- <span id="f-convertible"></span>`Convertible = 2` - A non-sRGB RGB matrix/TRC profile nfty can convert to sRGB.
- <span id="f-unsupported"></span>`Unsupported = 3` - A profile nfty cannot convert (LUT-only, gray, CMYK, malformed, oversized): the picture is imported as stored.
